arm_contract.parent: lean loader, contiguous CPU FP32 image ingress, pin_memory=false, non_blocking=false
arm_contract.candidate: lean loader, contiguous CPU uint8 image ingress, pin_memory=true, non_blocking=true

pairing_contract.semantic_binding: same ordered sample identities and canonical semantic SHA-256; the complete 360-pair live sequence is fingerprinted before timing and replay-checked

benchmark_scopes.model_only: preprocessed common FP32 boundary through model._run_forward; excludes loader, collate, pinning, preprocessing, and H2D
benchmark_scopes.input_pipeline_end_to_end: dataset loader/transforms plus collate/pinning plus preprocessor/H2D; excludes model execution
benchmark_scopes.combined_full_inference: not measured and no speed gate or claim

fail_closed_checks: sample identity or semantic digest mismatch
paired-batch swap or reuse in live measured pairs
parent/candidate ingress dtype, shape, layout, pinning, or non_blocking drift
execution without explicit ARMED state and the existing exact idle/reserved confirmation

cpu_tests.cuda_availability_calls: monkeypatched before pytest collection; no real CUDA discovery
cpu_tests.nvidia_smi: not invoked except mocked unit-test subprocess responses

limitations: The ARMED CUDA path has not been executed or numerically validated.
The two benchmark scopes are intentionally separate and must not be added into a synthetic full-inference claim.
The input-pipeline gate excludes model execution; the model-only gate is non-regression-only.
Full live-pair prevalidation warms filesystem/page caches; the input-pipeline result is explicitly a prevalidated warm-cache measurement.
Actual pinning, asynchronous transfer, CUDA stream, profiler, memory, latency, and environment evidence remain pending an authorized idle GPU run.
C32-versus-C0 near-native eligibility still requires a separately sealed true C0/C32 arm pair.
